source: NASA OSDR RadLab (Radiation Data Lab) Data API
processing: Raw readings for one day were averaged per instrument in a one-off script: mean, median, min and max of absorbed_dose_rate. Only these summaries are bundled.

Mars: MSL-RAD (on the Curiosity rover, on the surface)

unitCheck: The unit (microgray per hour) comes from the RadLab knowledge-base page for absorbed_dose_rate as quoted by a search result. That page and the data-api docs page returned HTTP 500 when fetched directly on 2026-11-14, so the unit was not read first-hand.
caveat: Instrument readings are samples taken at uneven times (more often near the South Atlantic Anomaly), so daily averages are rough.
